data.name: Uday
data.gender_notes: Uday is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Uday is derived from the Sanskrit word 'udita' which means 'rising'. It is a name that signifies new beginnings, hope, joy, and the dawn of a new day. It is believed that the name Uday brings happiness and success to those who bear it. The name Uday carries the meaning “Morning, Dawn” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Marathi. Parents who choose Uday usually hope their child will grow to embody morning, dawn and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Uday is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality. It is associated with the Hindu god Surya, the god of the sun. The name Uday is believed to bring the blessings of Surya to those who bear it.
data.etymology: Uday belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Morning, Dawn.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Uday total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

In Hindu mythology, the sun god Surya is considered the lord of the day, and his rising represents a new beginning, a new day, and hope for the future. The name Uday is a reminder of this daily renewal and the eternal cycle of life.
